en: A secret switch!
Press it?
Who wouldn't?
Better not...
Still nothing? Doesn't anywhere have it?
Oh, sorry. You can go ahead; I'm not in line or anything.
Even a place like this won't sell what I need.
My husband is seriously ill. I've been looking all over for anything that might cure him, and I heard a rumour about a certain herb, but I can't find it anywhere.
Not that I'm surprised. It's rare to find someone willing to cut off... Oh, well, nevermind.
That plant you have... That wouldn't happen to be Oddishweed, would it?
Really?
I almost hate to ask, but would you be willing to give me that? It's for my husband.
\PN handed over the Oddishweed.
This really is it! Thank you so much!
I was beginning to lose hope I would ever be able to find any.
Oh, I wish I could repay you somehow... Oh, actually, I suppose you must be a Trainer, right?
I've been breeding some Pokémon lately, and I have an extra egg. Do you want it?
\PN got the egg!
Take care of that, okay? And thank you again!
Well, I suppose that's your right... But where else will I find it?
Oh, sorry. You can go ahead, I'm not in line or anything.
My husband is seriously ill... I've been looking all over for anything that might cure him, and I heard a rumour about a certain herb, but I can't find it anywhere...
Not that I'm surprised. It's rare to find someone willing to cut off-- Oh, well, nevermind.
Anyway... I suppose I'll check again tomorrow.
Excuse me, very sorry, pardon!
...\PN's "Rare Candy" went missing!
Hey.
I remember you.
You were the one who saved me when I was trapped in Beryl.
Well, what am I doing in a place like this?
Don't worry, I'm still with the police. I'm here on business.
You're that Trainer who's been taking down Team Meteor and such, right?
Nice work. I think I can trust you, so I'll tell you a secret.
I'm actually with the police force.
The truth is, we've known about this place for quite a while.
There was some debate on if we should step in during the city restoration, and that may yet happen.
But for the time being, the chief's orders are just to monitor and leave it alone.
I can sort of guess what he's thinking.
If the people here think the police don't know about this place, they'll keep their business here.
This way we can keep watching them, collect evidence, and be able to nail them when it really counts.
If we were to pull a bust here, then what?
After a while they'd find some other cranny we don't know about to do their dirty work in, and we'll lose control that way.
So, you can leave this to us.
We'll make sure this place doesn't fester too much.
Take care. Reborn's got a lot riding on you.
HUSTLER: Howdy there!
I've got a special deal just for you!
It's a super rare and powerful Pokémon...
I acquired it recently after some of the gangs on the surface were squabbling over it!
For the price of two Blue Shards, this mysterious, rare and powerful Pokémon can be all yours!
HUSTLER: Sold!
Here you are, and thank you for your business!
???: A rare and powerful Pokémon?
Don't mind if I do.
Fwah!
???: Voila! I am Corin-Rouge, the dashing rogue!
CORIN-ROUGE: But-- ah! My fair lady!
I knew not 'twas you whom I sought the prize of rarity and power from--
Little did I know that there was a beauty of far greater rarity just about!
Alas, my heart is pained--
How could I steal from such a precious flower?
But I must!
Corin-Rouge stole the Pokémon!
CORIN-ROUGE: Weep for me, angels, for regret shall be my undoing!
Or perhaps not-- for what has been done, cannot be undone!
It is with great restraint, too, that I take from you merely this Pokémon.
For a lady such as you, I should steal a kiss as well.
But forsooth!
CORIN-ROUGE: It was not to be!
Our paths are too different, my lady; our futures too vast.
But I hope that one day you will think of me as I shall you: eyes, ravaged by beauty, and heart, by distance.
Adieu.
CORIN-ROUGE: As a man ever in pursuit of the finest Pokémon, it would hardly do to let such a prize slip past right under my nose. As such!
CORIN-ROUGE: And now, my getaway! May we meet again, never!
HUSTLER: Well, shucks.
By the way, we have a no refund policy, so that's rough.
Who knows? Maybe you'll see him again someday.
But I have a feeling a man like that can stay hidden as long as the city and police are in disarray.
HUSTLER: Too bad! Who would like to claim this fantastic beast?!
Hey, stranger. Is there something I can do you for-- er, for you?
I might be able to teach you a thing or two~
Role Play? Yeah, I get asked for that all the time. One Purple Shard?
Sorry, sugar, I don't work for free.
Thank you kindly. Come again... if you know what I mean~
Oh, how sweet of you! Three Blue Shards, yeah?
Electroweb, a shocking choice! Three Green Shards for that~
Sky Attack? I mean, I know some people feel a high afterwards, but... How about you give me two Red Shards and we call it square.
See you around, sweetheart.
ARCHER: We hadn't seen you around in a while, \PN.
I was beginning to worry something had happened.
Although, even if you're here now, there's probably still a lot that's gone on.
Everything's changed, except 7th Street.
But that just goes to show you this place wasn't as safe as we thought it was.
The Aqua Gang has kept busy too, but not with our usual method of business.
From the beginning, this operation was just an underhanded way to fix this city.
When this city started fixing itself, of course I had the other guys get involved.
Then, somewhere between purses and picks, and mortar and bricks, I realized something.
Even if we fix this city,
Nothing will fix us.
We're a crime rate.
We're a pattern of habits that pull each other into backwards lifestyles with shallow justifications.
I've decided to disband the Aqua Gang.
Unfortunately, I know it's not that simple.
Studies show that recidivism among gang members is particularly high unless they have adequate alternative social and economic structures.
In other words, nothing's going to change unless these guys have somewhere else to go instead.
For instance, if they got new jobs.
That could cover both halves of their needs fairly cleanly.
I've already talked about all of this with them, of course.
Predictably, they're not taking it seriously.
I'll continue to try and get through to them. In the meantime, I have a task for you.
They don't really have the motivation for normal work, but if you could find something that would interest each of them, that might change.
What I want you to do is talk to everyone, figure out what kind of place they might want to work, and bring them an application from that place.
It's not like they'll ask for an application though.
You'll probably have to be direct about it. Use it from your inventory.
You understand, right?
Come talk to me once you've got everyone else set on their path.
ARCHER: What I want you to do is talk to everyone, figure out what kind of place they might want to work, and bring them an application from that place.
ARCHER: So you were able to find something for everyone?
That's a relief.
Then I guess I'm the only one left.
It's true that I could just as well go out and search for myself,
But perhaps you've found something in your search for the others that might suit me?
My strengths lie in team coordination, research and analysis.
These are fairly marketable skills, so I hope something matches up.
MAXWELL: \PN! There you are!
We've been looking all over for you!
Feels like it's been ages. You've been doing good?
We've been doing more good than you would even believe.
Racking up that glory!
But no, I'm serious! Some of the guys were like, boohoo and whatever about pitching in with the city restoration, but we got a lot done!
I think it's eye-opening, to be able to look at something, point to it, and say,
That, right there.
I did that.
That was a difference I made.
It's what we've been chasing all along.
It's a legacy, you know?
That's why I've decided something.
I'm breaking up the Magma Gang.
I don't have any regrets.
For how the city was before, it was our best play.
But with how things are going now, it'd just be weighing us down.
We have a chance to rebuild this city from the ground up!
It's not just the stones we lay the foundation for, but the spirits too!
But if they stay cooped up in places like these, they'll never learn that.
7th Street is the only place that hasn't changed at all.
Not one bit!
Isn't that weird?
Something feels off about it.
That's how I know the other path is the right one!
In order to get the other guys to understand how to shape a future we can hold dear, what do we do?
I think a lot of them don't have the confidence or skills for that kind of thing.
That's why it'd be best to start with a small commitment, like a job.
If they had something to work at every day--
Something legal, mind you--
I think they'd begin to understand how to take pride in a normal life.
That's why I want you to help me!
I've already talked to the others about it, but they're not having a word of it.
It's all "work this" and "effort that."
I'll talk some sense into them, but in the meantime, I want you to do me a favor!
Have a word with everyone and see if you can think of anywhere they might actually want to get a job.
Still, they won't go seek it out.
But if you bring them an application from a place that sparks their interest, there might just be a chance!
I don't care if they don't want it, just shove it right in their faces from your item pocket or something!
After you've got everyone sorted, then come see me.  You got it?
Let's redefine glory, baby!
MAXWELL: Have a word with everyone and see if you can think of anywhere they might actually want to get a job.
MAXWELL: You got everyone already? Rock on!
Well, there's one more matter I was hoping to get your help in.
It's kind of embarrassing-- but I've also never really held a normal job.
Even so, I want to start now!
I want to work somewhere where I can make people smile, and leave glory shining in their hearts!
If I can make a difference, even for one person, that would be worth it.
But as for a job that would let me do that...
I'm at a loss.
Do you think anywhere like that exists in Reborn?
Maybe it doesn't yet... but what will I do in that case?
My friend! Why don't you see what I can do for you?
Hey, ain't it my favorite customer!
You recognize your friend in the Pokémon trading business?
Things struck a sour note after you swept my last stock and I got the fuzz on my tail for some time.
But you know how I roll. They can't keep me down!
And a guy's gotta pull Shards somehow, so here I am, now in the teachin' business.
Nothin' wrong with that, right?
So, why don't you see what I can do for you?
I can teach your crew some of this kinda stuff.
Knock Off? With a price of only 8 Red Shards, it's practically a rip off!
Hey, you may be my favorite customer, but this isn't a charity!
You gotta have the Shards to learn the arts!
Always a pleasure!
For just 7 Purple Shards, this Iron Head is practically a Steel!
Giga Drain brings the pain! For 6 Green Shards, it's your gain!
This may be Liquidation, but there ain't no sale, kid! 6 Blue Shards!
I'll be seeing you around!
Hello! Are you prepared to be amazed by the amazing moves of the Move Magician?!
Splendid! Just say the word and Paras-to Change-o!  Your Pokémon can learn one of these splendid attacks!
Tricks! My specialty. For two Purple Shards, I'll show you how you confound your opponents!
But don't you have Shards? I need enough to pay back Agate--
I mean... If I don't have Shards, I won't have enough mana to teach your Pokémon! Yes, that's it!
Abra! Kadabra! And Alomomola! Your Pokémon is now one move more amazing!
Ah yes, I can see it clearly now! Your Pokémon will learn Defog for the price of two Red Shards!
Laser Focus, is it? It won't even take an ounce of focus for me to pass that on! Just give me one Blue Shard and it's done!
The classic switcharooni! For one Green Shard, you too will make skills move in the blink of an eye!
Headbutt is gonna run you three Blue Shards.
Bounce is gonna run you three Purple Shards.
Heal Bell is gonna run you four Green Shards.
Bug Bite is gonna run you three Red Shards.

MELOETTA: Melolo~
RINGMASTER: What?!
It just ran off to the Battle Wheel too!

Good luck, or something.
RINGMASTER: Hi, \PN! You seem to have arrived at an interesting time!
Not that all of our times here at the circus aren't interesting! Come on by any day for a riled wide!
I mean, wild ride-- oh, forget it.

It's nice that things are starting to get back to normal, and the people who had to basically live here for a while are getting a little less repulsed by the idea of ever setting foot in this place again,
But then this one appeared and everyone just lost their mind!
MELOETTA: Meeeelo!
RINGMASTER: So I'm making the best of the situation!
I know you're the Legendary control crew, but...
I already publically agreed to the tournament so I can't just hand it over at this point!
But you're the Champion, right?!
How about you just participate and win, and then it's no problem, right?
Here! I'll even waive the entry fee for you, so try not to be too annoyed at me, okay?
And maybe toss some of that good ol' Champion- endorsement our way sometime if you get a chance, eh?
SAMSON: You're pushin' it, lass.
RINGMASTER: Please, it was just a joke! *
* Kinda.
MELOETTA: Lo.
RINGMASTER: Why must everyone around me call me out?!
SAMSON: She's been talking to that thing more and more all day.
I'm starting to think it's not healthy.
RINGMASTER: I'm perfectly healthy!
I'm the healthiest person on the planet!
SAMSON: Wouldn't be surprised if she eventually started hugging the Pokémon and calling it her precious.
RINGMASTER: Ew, no! I'm lightyears away from that creepy!
Anyway, I'll sign you up, \PN!
Just talk to one of the clown guys over by the Battle Wheel when you're ready to start the match.
The brackets will also be posted on the sign-boards on the right.
Make sure to check them so you can see who you're up against first!
SAMSON: All these years and she still hasn't thought of a better name than 'Battle Wheel'.
RINGMASTER: That's just what these things are called!
You have to put 'Battle' before the noun otherwise it's not even a real thing!
Ask anyone!
SAMSON: Sure. Meloetta, what do you think?
MELOETTA: Laaa~
RINGMASTER: No, don't do this to me...
RINGMASTER: Just talk to one of the clown guys over by the Battle Wheel when you're ready to start the match.
Aaaand if you happen to think of any names that could get either of these two to shut up, you just let me know!
RINGMASTER: All right everyone, listen up!
RINGMASTER: Round 1 has now completed!
Round 2 has been posted!
Stick with it for the sake of one ultra-precious autograph from the ultra-precious Meloetta!
SAMSON: You're really getting into it, boss.
RINGMASTER: Am not!
I'm just trying to hype up the crowd!
That's all!
MELOETTA: Lalala~
RINGMASTER: You can't just SAY these things!
SAMSON: Seek help, boss.
RINGMASTER: And what do you think you were supposed to be?!
No-- forget it.
Deep breaths, great vibes--
And now announcing the pairings for Round 2!
In the first quadrant!
Bee VS "Clarice!"
\PN VS Julia!
JULIA: Say whaaaaaaa--

"Mystery Participant" VS Techie Yan!
Break VS Gentleman Norman!

RINGMASTER: It's a mystery!
Duh; c'mon...

Samson VS Percy!
Hiker Oltan VS Cass!
MISS PERCY: Wait, you're pairing me against a gym leader?!
Why did I even show up?!
SAMSON: Sorry, lass.
A certain over-excitable Ringmaster went ahead and signed me up even though I was just supposed to be bouncing.
RINGMASTER: I had to make an even number somehow, and you volunteered!
SAMSON: Whether or not I did, I'm afraid my pride won't let me go easy on you.
RINGMASTER: Maybe I should've just signed your pride up as a separate participant anyway.
It seems to have more agency over you than anything else...
Quadrant four!
Battle Girl Yselda VS Lumi!
Posh Rachy VS Santiago!

RINGMASTER: And that's it!
Sixteen remain-- give it your best, each and all of you!

We'll be here dealing with Samson's pride in the meantime~
RINGMASTER: All right, and that's Round 2!
RINGMASTER: Congrats to everyone who's made it this far except Samson!
SAMSON: Keep talkin', lass.
MELOETTA: Melemele~
SAMSON: You tell her.
RINGMASTER: Now we'll announce the pairings for Round 3!
"Clarice" VS \PN!
"Mystery Participant" VS Break!
Samson's Pride VS Cass!
SAMSON: Beg your pardon?
RINGMASTER: And Lumi VS Santiago!
SANTIAGO: Fuck yeah! Let's fuckin' go!
I'mma fuck this fuckin' shit all the way up!
All for that fuckin' Meloetta, you hear?!
LUMI: O-oh.
RINGMASTER: That's it!
Good luck to everyone!
RINGMASTER: Isn't it awfully generous of me to host a whole tournament to give others the chance to appreciate Meloetta?!
I think it is.
The things we do for Meloetta~
...And for the business!
RINGMASTER: All right, let's go over the results of Round 3 as we move into the semifinals!
RINGMASTER: In the first match, \PN trounced the robo-Breloom known as Clarice!
SAMSON: Anyone know why that thing was here in the first place?

RINGMASTER: In the third match, Samson's Pride was eliminated by Cass!
SAMSON: ...
RINGMASTER: Just, absolutely stepped on and destroyed!

But some might say that was bound to happen to someone like Samson's Pride.
SAMSON: You're gonna need to find yourself a new bouncer.
RINGMASTER: Okay, okay-- and in the fourth match, Lumi prevailed against Santiago!
LUMI: He taught me a new word!
MELOETTA: Melo!
RINGMASTER: Meloetta's right! This show needs to keep moving!
So the semifinal pairs!
\PN VS "Mystery Participant"!
Cass VS Lumi!
Let's hop to it!
RINGMASTER: Not long now!
RINGMASTER: The semifinals are over!
Let's go over the results!
First up--
CASS: The results are apparent.
The final match is me and \PN.
Let's just get to it already.
SAMSON: ...Aaand in the last match, the Ringmaster's Pride was utterly destroyed by Cass.
RINGMASTER: But-- the fanfare...
Oh, fine.
I thought more people would be sticking around after elimination anyway...
Maybe they're just down in the main area, buying merchandise?
SAMSON: Yeah, I don't know about all that.
RINGMASTER: But... my sales...
RINGMASTER: What about my sales...?
RINGMASTER: So, that's it! Tournament's over!
Congratulations to our winner, \PN!
...She says to the remaining crowd of... nobody.
SAMSON: I'm right here.
RINGMASTER: Samson, I'd say something like "You don't count," but it really doesn't do the extent to which you do not count any remote justice.
Pre-schoolers count better than you do.
The fenceposts count more than you do.
That pebble over there on the ground?
That counts more than you do.
Just move out of the way so that \PN can get their promised autograph.
SAMSON: I thought you'd never ask.
RINGMASTER: ...You won't do something silly like, just catch the Pokémon, right?

...Haha?
RINGMASTER: Wow, \PN, I was sure you'd win!
Kinda relieved if I'm being honest-- I didn't want you to try and take this thing away from us.
It's for the good of the circus!
But Cass already came and got the autograph and left, so your ship has unfortunately sailed!
That's okay-- try again next tournament, maybe!
Until then, right?
SAMSON: You serious right now?
You know these Anomaly things can be dangerous, right?
RINGMASTER: B-but the profits!
The attraction!
SAMSON: Yeah, forget this.

If you want to safeguard it so badly, you can be your own bouncer.
I'm out. See you next show.
RINGMASTER: Wait wait wait, seriously?!
You're doing this now?!
But what about the --
RINGMASTER: ...Ugh.

I guess.

But I'm not here to judge.
I'll still do it, but it's not what I'm here for...
Just do whatever you want, I guess.
RINGMASTER: Y-you should probably just catch the thing...
Maybe consider donating it?
...Maybe not...
RINGMASTER: Maybe this thing is making me moody...
SAMSON: Sorry, champ-- I can't let even you through here.
Boss's orders.
This thing showed up here this morning and the moment she laid claim to it, I swear you could see her pupils morph into dollar signs.
I've got a hunch that this is gonna be a short term deal only, so forgive me for not breaking contract for you right off the bat.
But you better believe if this goes on too long, we'll be talking again.
SAMSON: So I'm up against that Percy girl, huh...
Something tells me it won't be much of a match.
SAMSON: See you in the finals, \PN.
SAMSON: Sometimes I wonder why I put up with all this.
SAMSON: We done here yet?
LUMI: Hi, \PN!
Cass and I were just talking about Glaceon and how cute and talented it is!
It's really saved me in a few tight spots when we've been out hunting Legendaries a few times too!
LUMI: This is the first time I'm really fighting on my own!
I've learned a lot from my sister, and--
Well, even from Zero too.
But do you really think it's enough to stand among the best of them?
LUMI: Wow, I'm really pulling through!
I gotta tell Eve when I see her!
LUMI: Good luck!
I'm gonna do my best in this one too!

I wasn't originally gonna come to the circus today, but then I suddenly felt a calling.
Like I had to be here...
Like there was missed screen time to make up for!
Do you ever get that feeling? Is that just me?
Or did someone misplace a wall somewhere?
JULIA: Apparently they had to pull me out of the gondola cuz I fell asleep in there.
But it's so cozy-- why shouldn't I take a power nap after the match?!
JULIA: So you and I are fighting next, huh?
Then let's be sure to make this an explosive--
Wait, no, hold on.
JULIA?: Fufufu, \PN, so we meet again...
Fool you were to approach me as such,
For I shall take great pleasure in, as they say,
Cleaning your alarm clock...
Quiver in fear and other various emotions, \PN, for our battle shall truly be legendary!
Get it? Legendary?
Cuz-- Meloetta-- and--
It was funny; I promise!
MCKREZZY: I've gotta admit, I'm not used to being in a crowd like this without being the center of its attention.
I find myself torn.
On one hand, it is almost refreshing.
On another, I find it incites a burning drive to rise to even greater heights!
With Meloetta's help, no doubt I'll make it there.
SANTIAGO: Yo, what the fuck is up!?
Long time no fuckin' see!
Shoulda known a fucker like you'd be in this fuckin' place!
Got fuckin' taste!
Meloetta's the fuckin' bomb!
SANTIAGO: Meloetta's the fuckin' bomb!
Just look how fuckin' cute it is!
I'mma fuck you up and get that fuckin' thing's fuckin' autograph; just you fuckin' see!
Gonna have that fuckin' Meloetta drop a signature on my bald fuckin' head!
Eternal, shiny and fuckin' signed-- let's fuckin' DO this!
SANTIAGO: Fuck yeah! I'm climbing the fuck up this bracket!
My chrome fucking dome is ready for this shit!
Gonna fuck up whatever fucker tries to keep me from Meloetta!
MISS PERCY: Gosh, there's just something about Meloetta.
I'm waiting for her Pirouette form personally.
Seeing a girl like that kick butt like "Hiyaaah!"
That's worth fighting for, don't you think?
MISS PERCY: I should've just stayed in the desert...
I never should've come here...
Oh, hey, I remember you!
You're the one who stole--
Er, um...
Borrowed!
Borrowed that TV for me!
